name: HYDRA-UMC-MQTT-BROKER
notes: Real MQTT broker over real TCP. Optional MQTT CONNECT username/password authentication (MQTT_AUTH_JSON) gives the opt-in per-client-ID-prefix topic ACL (MQTT_ACL_JSON) a verified session identity; ACL scope checks prevent wildcard SUBSCRIBE escalation. An optional MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES cap is enforced on every PUBLISH. All three controls are verified with real Aedes and MQTT clients, not only unit math.
